# Printora — Full Technical Documentation & Architecture Manual

## Overview
Printora is an open-source wireless mobile printing and document scanning utility that connects modern mobile devices (Android, iPhone, iPad) to any printer managed by a host Windows PC (Windows 10, Windows 11).

## Architecture & Communication Protocols
1. **Host Server (.NET 8)**:
   - Runs as a Windows background service or system tray utility.
   - Interfaces directly with the Windows Print Spooler API (`winspool.drv`).
   - Listens on a local HTTP/TLS server port (default 8080/8443).
   - Broadcasts network presence via mDNS (`_printora._tcp.local`) and UDP beacon broadcast on the local subnet.
2. **Android App (Native Kotlin & Jetpack Compose)**:
   - Performs network service discovery (NSD) for mDNS services on Wi-Fi.
   - Establishes TLS socket connection to the host PC.
   - Transmits print jobs directly to the Windows server with progress telemetry.
   - Includes on-device camera scanner with document edge detection and perspective warp correction.
   - Supports ID card scanning mode: captures front and back sides and renders both onto a single printable A4 sheet.
   - Performs on-device OCR using Google ML Kit for text extraction.
3. **QR Web Print Studio (iOS & Web Clients)**:
   - Generates a dynamic QR code on the Windows desktop app.
   - Scanning the QR code with iPhone Camera opens the Web Print Studio in mobile Safari over local Wi-Fi or Cloudflare Tunnel.
   - Browser client uploads PDF or images directly into the local print queue without installing any iOS app.
   - Ephemeral session tokens authenticate each upload.
4. **Remote Access via Cloudflare Tunnel**:
   - Optional outbound-only reverse tunnel connecting the Windows server to Cloudflare Edge.
   - Bypasses NAT and ISP carrier firewalls without opening incoming ports on the local router.
   - Secured with optional 6-digit PIN authentication or access tokens.

## File Format Support & Conversion Engine
- **Direct Spooling**: PDF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, BMP, GIF, TXT.
- **Office Documents (DOC, DOCX)**: Converted server-side using headless LibreOffice installed on the Windows PC.

## Security & Privacy Guardrails
- Local-first architecture: In standard Wi-Fi mode, data never leaves the local LAN.
- Zero Cloud Retention: Print jobs received by the Windows server are spooled to temporary disk storage and purged immediately upon spooler handoff.
- TLS communication with SHA-256 certificate pinning on the Android app.
- Rate limits on Web Print Studio: Max 3 copies, max 30 PDF pages, 2 jobs/minute per IP.
